rows.text: The President's Secretariat release of 29 July 2022 says the President received the Mozambican delegation as the first international delegation after her assumption of the office on 25 July 2022.
A parliamentary delegation from Mozambique called on the President of India, Smt Droupadi Murmu, at Rashtrapati Bhavan on 29 July 2022.
